I - PART A - FIXED COST - Management Contract for Operation and Maintenance of water supply to Ramanagara City up to end user point py deploying required man power, i.e operations staff/chemist/maintaince staff / Billing staff / Revenue Collection/office staff and attending repairs and providing consumables for the work of following: a) Operation and maintenance of upto 42 MLD of water supply system including Civil Works such as  raw water pipeline,water treatment plant at T.K. Hally, MBR & Intermidiate pumping stations at Aralalasandra, Two MBR's at Ramanagaram along with allied components including MS /DI/HDPE pipe lines of different diameters ranging from 75 mm to 965 mm up to consumer point, over head tanks,Valves of all kinds, other appurtances like Chlorinators etc, b) Providing Chemicals(excluding cost of chemical), consumbles etc required for water supply such as ebonite balls, gaskets, grease,Lurication Oil,cotton waste,cleaning agent-phenyle etc. (PAC, Bleaching Powder & Chlorine) c) Patrolling of pipe line ( Both Bulk and Distrubution) along the alignment, attending minor leakages in distribution pipeline, Bulk Pipeline and valves etc., in Ramanagara city provided under the existing water supply scheme of Ramanagara , excluding cost of pipe and valves. (i) Tank shall be emptied of water by pumping & bottom shall be cleaned of silt and other deposits.
(ii) Entire surface area of the sump shall then scrubbed thoroughly with wire brush etc. and pressure washed with water.
(iii) Bleaching of RCC internal surface. 
(iv) The treated surface shall be dried using air jetting and all loose particles shall be removal from the surface etc. as per direction of Engineer-in-Charge.
